Question: OpenVPN (hybrid connectivity)

Question: IKEv2 (hybrid connectivity)
Answer: cross-platform, certificate auth

Question: SSTP (hybrid connectivity)
Answer: Windows-only, used for legacy

Question: Point-to-point Ethernet (hybrid connectivity)

Question: Hub VNet connections (hybrid connectivity)

Answer: on-prem locations with VPN connectivity to hubs

Question: Azure Private DNS resolver (hybrid connectivity)
Answer: hosts a DNS resolver in your VNet that on-prem can query (forwarded from on-prem DNS)
